learning_outcomes.text: The seminar presentation provides students with the basic knowledge of scientific presenting under guidance.
They are able to independently prepare and deliver a presentation.
They can create an initial manuscript of the presentation with the essential content in advance and submit it on time.
They are able to summarize the presentation content in a limited number of words (abstract).
They can cite scientifically correctly and create a source reference.
They know methods for effectively using language and body language.
They can give constructive criticism and deal with constructive criticism themselves.

syllabus_topics: Independent selection of the presentation topic
Elaboration of the presentation, a presentation, and a short summary
Defending the presentation in a Q&A session
assessment_rules: The assessment is based on a presentation of approximately 30 minutes, including discussion, within the seminar. This presentation accounts for 100% of the module grade.
